name: augmented-treality-app
description: Augmented Treality as native iPhone and Android apps (Capacitor). The app is the web builder in ../augmented-treality plus a native AR viewer.

scripts.android: node scripts/stage.mjs && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.ios: node scripts/stage.mjs && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.apk: node scripts/stage.mjs && npx cap sync android && cd android && gradlew.bat assembleDebug
